import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Data loading
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Data preprocessing
df['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(df['StichtagDat'])
df['Year'] = df['StichtagDat'].dt.year

# Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='Year', hue='KreisLang', palette='Set2')
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Year and District')

plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.legend(title='District')
